scope: Read-only source review plus all 8 actual executor fixture tests, 6 independent nested-path permutations and two tiny fixture executions checking successful-predecessor repeat. All runs nice15 in temporary domains. Only this review JSON written.

independent_nested_permutations.result: All rejected through dispatch.enqueue; no launches from invalid plans.

successful_predecessor_repeat.result: Explicit same-job repeat with accepted_execution predecessor, exact terminal pin, new attempt/output and reason was admitted, launched and released accepted_execution.
successful_predecessor_repeat.meaning: Predecessor lineage is authenticated; failure-only retry policy is not enforced. No scientific approval follows.

critical_checks: Reservation commits before executor preparation. Domain flock serializes cooperating callers. Actual caller-death probes after reservation/preparation/launch/release insert/release commit pass. Release and capacity transition are one SQLite record transaction.

Exact registered unused preparation resumes within same reservation only before launch intent. Partial scaffolds retain; launch intent prevents automatic relaunch. Dispatcher contains no stop/recover calls.

Active canonical reservation and selected admission/spec/source/input/ownership checks execute synchronously. Tested source/input/reservation/specification/predecessor-terminal/terminal drift retains capacity.

Release uses original executor inspect, validated terminal and evidence pins, verified cleanup, no held job lock, no live recorded process/session and known return code. Actual unknown exit remains reserved after fixture supervisor kill and explicit stop/recover.

Duplicate attempts/output paths use V2 admission. Six independent same-plan nonadjacent nested cases rejected; authored capacity test prevents second job preparation while first live or cleanup unverified.

Current config/V2/original executor dependency hashes verified. Original queue/executor/ledger agree with prior independent V2 pins. Tests launch and signal only temp fixture identities, not real owner jobs.

preserved_failure_assessment.fixed_sleep: Two terminal FileNotFoundErrors occurred with insufficient fixed delay. Current tests poll actual terminal and process/lock/session settlement; original executor gates unchanged.
preserved_failure_assessment.pre_gate_kill: Explicit stop correctly refused unresolved ownership when supervisor killed before recorded child anchor. Current test waits for actual child receipt, proving a later crash boundary only. Earlier failure remains preserved.
preserved_failure_assessment.limit: No arbitrary fsync/power-loss crash proof or exhaustive pre-gate lifecycle coverage.

nonblocking_findings.finding: Explicit retries/repeats after successful predecessor are allowed, independently reproduced.
nonblocking_findings.recommendation: Clarify documentation so retry-after-failure wording is not mistaken for a failure-status gate; add such policy only if intended.

retained_limitations: Trusted mutable SQLite/config can be coherently rewritten/rolled back. Installed triggers and digests are not independent historical protection. Consistent forged release rows can defeat historical capacity; explicitly outside contract.
Released history is not revalidated at every tick; no dispatch-wide historical audit or protected head.
No DAG dependency/producer result authority, controller service, migration, cancellation or automatic repair/recovery. Partial/unknown reservations can block forever.
No scale claim; current selected plan validation can inspect siblings. No comprehensive concurrent-dispatch adversarial campaign or physical crash durability proof.
Source/config pinning is local integrity, not scientific authorization. Actual-input approval and meaningful forecast qualification are absent.
owner_noninterference: Source hashes match authored/available prior independent pins. Fixture cleanup enumerates only temp executor/controllers substores and signals their recorded identities. No owner path, production queue, global stop or real-job operation used. This is scoped evidence, not a global filesystem forensic proof.
conclusion: No blocking defect found within the explicit independent-job/cooperative mutable-storage research contract. Actual subprocess lifecycle and bounded crash/reconciliation behavior pass. V1 path failure remains preserved; no production or scientific adoption supported.
